title: Simulate mac-cleanup to see what will be removed
summary: Run mac-cleanup in dry-run mode to preview which caches and junk files would be deleted without actually removing them. This is a safe way to check what the tool does.

steps.explain: Use the --dry-run flag to simulate the cleanup process. The tool will list the files it would remove but will not delete them.
steps.expect: A list of files and directories that would be removed is displayed, but no files are actually deleted.
